tagline.en: AC is now Arcade Chips, with new chip and gem art, avatar decorations and Who's online.
tagline.id: AC sekarang Arcade Chips, dengan desain chip dan gem baru, dekorasi avatar, dan daftar online.

items.en: AC is now called Arcade Chips: a gold casino chip. AG gets a new brilliant-cut gem.
items.id: AC sekarang bernama Arcade Chips: chip kasino emas. AG punya desain permata baru.

items.en: Avatar frames are now decorations around your avatar: laurels, crystals, flames, orbit, crown, roses and more. Shop emotes are drawn, not emoji.
items.id: Bingkai avatar sekarang dekorasi di sekeliling avatar: daun laurel, kristal, api, orbit, mahkota, mawar, dan lainnya. Emote di shop digambar, bukan emoji.

items.en: Who's online on the home page and house bots (tagged BOT) in live bets. Admins can switch bots off.
items.id: Daftar Siapa yang online di beranda dan bot rumah (bertanda BOT) di live bets. Admin bisa mematikan bot.

items.en: Snake gets a jungle board with stone and gold tiles and a pawn. Pump is centered with the multiplier on the balloon.
items.id: Snake punya papan hutan dengan kotak batu dan emas serta pion. Pump di tengah dengan pengali di balon.

items.en: Horse Racing: horses run past the finish line and the winner crosses first. Crash: the rocket no longer shakes at the start.
items.id: Horse Racing: kuda berlari melewati garis finis dan pemenang melewatinya duluan. Crash: roket tidak bergetar lagi di awal.
